mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing Augustine and Luther was most worthwhile: it distinguished help with acting from what makes someone right with God, rather than treating them as answering the same question.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive explanations of feeding a neighbour were clear but repetitive; the household example largely restated the preceding result.

surprise.text: The comparison changed my understanding by showing that the two writers’ accounts of grace address different questions.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though connecting the household example repeated a point already made rather than adding much.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for more comparisons that clarify differences between writers, though I would hope for less repetition.
